title: A listener that sets another property while being notified: every listener hears both changes

docs.says: Called when a property of the tree the listener was added to changes, and also when a property of any descendant changes, at any depth.

notes: The documentation does not say in which order listeners are called, so the expected calls are compared as a set (a multiset where a call repeats). record_order asks the harness to record JUCE's actual sequence for the open ordering questions in docs/design/0005-state-arena-spike.md. Open question 2 (is the nested change delivered depth-first, before 'plain' hears x?) is observed here. Syrp queues it after the current change.
